incidents.title: Node.js Heap Memory Leak — Global Cache Accumulation
incidents.root_cause: Unbounded global array accumulation in Node.js heap memory due to missing eviction policy in globalEventCache
incidents.fix: Implement an eviction policy for the globalEventCache array, such as a TTL (time-to-live) or LRU (least-recently-used) cache, to prevent unbounded growth and reduce memory usage. Consider using a more efficient data structure, such as a Map or a dedicated caching library, to store and manage user event data.

Additionally, monitor and adjust the cache size and eviction policy based on production workload and performance metrics.
